EXACTLY ONE INPUT IS STILL CALLER-SUPPLIED — the `AdmissionGate` in `payload.budget.gate` — because no production module produces one from durable records. `packages/scheduler/src/node-authority/node-authority-contract.ts:54` states this outright: the node carries a gate POLICY (`NodeAdmissionGatePolicy`, HUMAN_APPROVAL | POLICY_ALLOWANCE) and "the corresponding AdmissionGate witness is resolved later from durable facts". Nothing resolves it yet.

WHAT LANDED IN THE MEANTIME, so this row is not re-implementing it. `apps/daemon/src/activation/activation-budget-stage.ts` `checkGateWitness` enforces the one thing that can be enforced without a producer: the witness FIELD the node's own policy names (`NODE_ADMISSION_GATE_POLICY_WITNESS[policy]`) must be PRESENT on the supplied gate, refusing ACTIVATION_BUDGET_GATE_WITNESS_MISMATCH / ACTIVATION_BUDGET_GATE_MALFORMED at DAEMON_INGRESS. That guard exists because `@moe/scheduler`'s own `checkGate` (`packages/scheduler/src/budget/budget-reservation.ts:152`) accepts EITHER witness — its only absence rule is `allowance === null && approval === null` — so without it a HUMAN_APPROVAL node is satisfiable by a policy allowance alone. Whether the witness ALLOWS is still `checkGate`'s call. What is NOT enforced anywhere: that the witness is REAL. A caller can still assert `{allowance: {decisionRef: "anything", outcome: "ALLOW"}}` and no durable record is consulted.

OBJECTIVE: resolve the AdmissionGate from DURABLE records — the policy decision aggregate for POLICY_ALLOWANCE and the human approval aggregate for HUMAN_APPROVAL — keyed by the node's `admissionGatePolicy`, so `activation-budget-stage.ts` stops reading `payload.budget.gate` entirely and the last caller-supplied budget input becomes unrepresentable.

SEQUENCING: must land before task-b8b69e7434ae44e2b00e53f144ecd875 (fence link 4, which retires the caller budget section from the payload contract) — after that row there is no `payload.budget` to read a gate from at all.
definitionOfDone: The AdmissionGate handed to reserveBudgetForAdmission on the authenticated effect.activate path is derived from durable approval/policy-decision records keyed by the node's own admissionGatePolicy; payload.budget.gate is never read on that route.

A forged or absent witness refuses with an exact stable reason code and the refusing layer, distinguishing 'no durable witness exists' from 'the durable witness does not allow' — and the existing ACTIVATION_BUDGET_GATE_WITNESS_MISMATCH / ACTIVATION_BUDGET_GATE_MALFORMED codes keep their meaning or are explicitly superseded.

A HUMAN_APPROVAL node cannot be satisfied by a policy allowance and a POLICY_ALLOWANCE node cannot be satisfied by a human approval — asserted in both directions against the production surface, not a helper.

Real SqliteEventStore plus authenticated-handler tests with nonzero executed counts; mutating the durable read reddens named assertions, and pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test reports a nonzero Test Files N passed line.
